sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies Miasma for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fete Element (increases all stats by 100%, increases cost recovery speed by 10, Ability Power is boosted by 30 when attacking an enemy in Break) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Dark and Time Defense from Unison Damage +500
